question: Do DepMap-24Q4-derived context->dependency associations replicate in BioGRID ORCS independent genome-scale screens (post-24Q4 publications prioritized)?
why_it_is_worth_registering: ORCS is a curated repository of published CRISPR screens outside the DepMap pipeline - library, lab, scorer and (by PMID filter) data-generation independent. 25Q3 DepMap itself ingests only 22 ORCS screens; the full human archive is ~1,952 screens.

data.discovery: DepMap 24Q4 per-library matrices (AV and KY as separate arms where usable)
data.holdout: BioGRID ORCS archive build 2.0.18 (2025-09-09), human.zip - whole file pinned by sha256, fetched sealed post-freeze from downloads.thebiogrid.org
data.usable_screen_filter: human (index covers the human tarball) AND LIBRARY_METHODOLOGY contains 'Knockout' AND SCREEN_TYPE contains 'Negative Selection' AND PHENOTYPE in {viability, proliferation, growth, cell viability, survival} AND FULL_SIZE_AVAILABLE == 'Yes' AND SOURCE_TYPE == 'pubmed' AND SCREEN_ID resolves to a screen file AND a resolvable per-gene score column with decidable direction
data.exclusion: ORCS screens whose PMID maps to DepMap ingest (Meyers 2017 29083409; Behan 2019 30971826; verify Pacini 2024 38215750) are excluded from the holdout
data.score_normalization: within-screen rank of the per-gene effect column; no cross-study raw-score comparison

registered_predictions.P1: primary pairs replicate at >= 0.30 of tested pairs; replication = dep_gene's within-screen lethal-rank separation, ctx-positive < ctx-negative, one-sided Mann-Whitney with BH q <= 0.10, each arm >= 3 usable mapped screens
registered_predictions.P2: placebo pairs replicate at <= 0.15 of tested placebo pairs
registered_predictions.P5: gold controls (depmap controls file, meets_discovery_floor subset) replicate at >= 0.5 of tested gold pairs
registered_predictions.P3: replication split reported by cell-line overlap class (same line vs disjoint lines) - reported, not gated

labels.ORCS_REPLICATED: P1 and P5 pass and P2 does not breach
labels.PLACEBO_BREACH: P2 fails with >= 1 tested placebo pair
labels.NOT_EVALUABLE: no primary or gold pair tested

caveats: ORCS has no QC gate - per-study variability must be checked inside the registered pipeline.
Many screens share DepMap-covered cell lines; shared vs disjoint replication is reported separately.
Publication date (PMID) is the temporal proxy; deposit-date fields do not exist in ORCS.
Score heterogeneity (BAGEL/MAGeCK/CERES/L2FC) is handled by rank normalization; hit-only screens give no usable denominator.
open_items: fetch the ORCS index TSV (metadata) to enumerate usable screens and verify the PMID exclusion list
resolve the DepMap-portal bot-wall question for 25Q3 (browser route vs figshare mirror)
register the per-screen effect-column mapping (ORCS score_type vocabulary)
